race.comment: Cracking race. CHILLY GIRL (7) resumes. Showed good acceleration on debut when she led throughout to score a decisive win in the G3 Widden Stakes over this track and trip last January. Trialled well and Clark sticks from the good draw. Go close. BLUE DOOR (6) resumes. Lived up to expectations on debut when she held on gamely to score in the G3 Kindergarten Stakes over 1100m at Randwick last April. Back with the one trial placing over 1000m and gets every chance. CASTILLO KING (10) made a mess of them on debut from the inside draw with a slick 3 len win over 1100m at Warwick Farm. Kept up to the mark with a trial placing over 792m at Warwick Farm. Can take a hand in the finish from the sticky gate. CENTRAL EUROPE (3) exciting colt resuming. Finished a narrow second in the G2 Skyline on debut. Back with the two trials and look for him savaging the line. Will keep improving as he steps out in trip. SHE'S EXTRA (14) has the upside to go on with it this prep and trialled well.
